critical_cases.name: Elite Opener
critical_cases.description: Opening batter facing calm platform (0/0) with elite individual & team execution
critical_cases.expected_behavior: Excellent score; small context dampening; not unfairly penalized

critical_cases.name: Failed Opener
critical_cases.description: Opening batter failing cheaply under calm platform
critical_cases.expected_behavior: Low contribution; low P1 must NOT protect poor batting

critical_cases.name: Normal Batter
critical_cases.description: Par context entry with high execution
critical_cases.expected_behavior: L = 1.000 exact; zero leverage distortion; score matches raw 50/50 mean

critical_cases.name: Moderate Collapse Rescue
critical_cases.description: Batting after moderate top-order wobble (e.g. 35/3, P1 ≈ 70)
critical_cases.expected_behavior: Higher contextual reward than an equivalent opener

critical_cases.name: Severe Collapse Rescue
critical_cases.description: Heroic rescue from catastrophic collapse (e.g. 25/4, P1 ≈ 85)
critical_cases.expected_behavior: Strongest legitimate reward; receives MORE contextual leverage than elite opener

critical_cases.name: Collapse Failure
critical_cases.description: Batter entering in crisis and failing immediately (scores 2 off 4, out)
critical_cases.expected_behavior: Strong penalty; zero participation cushion; no points for crisis entry

critical_cases.name: Collapse Passenger
critical_cases.description: Batter entering in crisis and batting exactly at par (50/50)
critical_cases.expected_behavior: Score ≈ 50.0; high P1 alone must NEVER create a high score

critical_cases.name: Death-Over Hopeless Chase
critical_cases.description: Batter entering in overs 18-20 with mathematical RRR blowout (P3-ISSUE-01)
critical_cases.expected_behavior: Investigate carefully; high leverage amplifies P3 blowout downward; separate reporting
